question: In a certain code language TEACHER is coded as REHCAET. How would the word STUDENT be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Each word is coded in reverse order.

The code for teacher is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9253d74bd04bc7d57c62726529383071fea817caab322e6861847af764aca50.png] 

Similarly, the code for STUDENT is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/401c670e87f471990b67b816203ab5f8af7a61db8c055498147dfffb67a9345b.png] 

Hence, the code for STUDENT will be 'TNEDUTS'.
